available_evidence_sources.quote: **The strongest result is a reusable way to certify relative mean waiting times for rare complete configurations from acquired local information, without computing a partition function. The theorem now permits a relaxation gap that shrinks with system size.** I also constructed an exact failure of the natural extension to coarse events. That failure identifies the next substantive object: the dynamics of entering and moving around an absorbing boundary, including the memory lost when its states are merged.
